_pipeline_lineage.title: Density-Based Spatial Clustering (DBSCAN) for Noise Filtering

upstream.source_data: Stage 09/10 distance metrics and feature coordinates.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: Ad traffic contains high-density legitimate user clusters surrounded by sparse bot/outlier impressions.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Spherical distance-based clustering fails when clusters have arbitrary shapes or when massive noise exists. DBSCAN connects core points with density >= MinPts within epsilon.
mathematical_transition.formula: N_\epsilon(p) = \{q \in D \mid \text{dist}(p, q) \le \epsilon\}, \quad |N_\epsilon(p)| \ge \text{MinPts} \implies \text{Core Point; else Noise } (-1)
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N \log N) \text{ with spatial indexing; Space: } \mathcal{O}(N)

downstream.hand_off_contract: Identifies 70.8% noise ratio under strict metric threshold, motivating dimensionality reduction and dedicated fraud detection.

adtech_role.system_component: Traffic Quality Scrubber & Bot Traffic Filter
adtech_role.business_impact: Separates organic user traffic from bot network bursts before feeding training logs to machine learning pipelines.
